title: Polygon Achieves Over 811 Million Transactions, Strengthening Its Position in Web3
description:
Learn more: https://www.crypto-news-flash.com/polygon-surpasses-811-million-transactions-cementing-web3-dominance/

Polygon (MATIC), the Ethereum scaling solution, is currently in a potential buy zone despite its recent 11% increase in value. This comes after the approval of spot Ethereum ETFs, which is expected to boost Ethereum-related cryptocurrencies. Notably, 82% of MATIC holders are out of the money, indicating that the asset might still be undervalued. Trading volume has surged from $17 million to $86 million, showing a significant influx of large holder investments, suggesting a bullish market sentiment. However, with MATIC showing a 60% concentration in whale holdings, retail investors should remain cautious as sudden sell-offs could impact prices adversely. As the market watches for MATIC to potentially break the $0.7778 resistance or dip below the $0.695 support, the coming weeks could be critical for investors.
